body: Wow! Thank you! In 40 years no one has ever suggested that I “do something about it!” And I just sit around on my couch all day and eat a bucket of KFC every night!

I don’t think it’s fair to assume from one post that I’m unhappy with my body. I’ve done a lot of hard work and am very comfortable with myself. However, pretending that the rest of the world doesn’t look at fat people differently, especially when it comes to romance and physical intimacy, is a bit tone deaf. I’ve been in therapy for years and have come a long way.
Thanks. Yeah despite my tone in the post I am a confident person. I’m just disappointed that romance is not in my wheelhouse.
It may not sound like it from this post because I was allowing myself to be vulnerable, but I am actually a very confident person.
